title: JA Voyara 1.0.8 and Tracy Business 1.2.3 are pinned end to end: contracts in the tree naming the published archives and Claude Cowork for Joomla 0.24.27, maxVersion 1.0.8 and 1.2.3, every Joomla quickstart pinned on 0.24.27 in both catalogues
steps: S1: Read packages/cms/tracy-joomla-quickstart/contracts/ja-voyara/j6/1.0.8/* and tracy-business/j6/1.2.3/* with their .design.json and .copy.json, packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/templates/joomla-ja-voyara.json and joomla-tracy-business.json, and both quickstarts.json catalogues.
expect: S1: every contract file exists; manifest ids ja-voyara/j6/1.0.8 (quickstart/ja-voyara/j6 1.0.8, webroot ja-voyara-j6-webroot-1.0.8.tar.gz sha256 e71d15d7…1a8dde) and tracy-business/j6/1.2.3 (tracy-business/j6 1.2.3, webroot tracy-business-j6-webroot-1.2.3.tar.gz sha256 04ec5c41…4bb511), coworkContractVersion 0.24.27, the Tracy Business sidecar maps pinned to 1.2.3; maxVersion 1.0.8 and 1.2.3 not below minVersion with notes naming them; the catalogue rows serve those versions and name those contracts; every Joomla pin in apps/tracy-web/src/quickstarts.json is 0.24.27 or newer and the provision copy pins the same.
S2: the door tests pass: the moved maxVersions are offered and the next version refused.
evidence: Before this PR the Design system door stopped at 1.0.7 and 1.2.2 (TEMPLATE_VERSION_UNCHECKED for a site built from 1.0.8 or 1.2.3) and no Claude Cowork pin carried the two contracts
fence: Both releases were verified from their own archives (VERIFICATION.json and VERIFICATION-1.2.3.json on the releases); JA Voyara's css files are byte-identical to 1.0.7, Tracy Business keeps the 1.2.2 database
